html: 『This Life and Eternity — Alert or Slumbering』
Life and Death — a hair's breadth apart
[ 回 到 生 死 之 間 ]
[ B A C K   T O   B E T W E E N   L I F E   A N D   D E A T H ]
js: 按著定命，人人都有一死\n死後且有審判
As it is appointed to man, that he must die once, and after that come judgment\nAnd after death there is judgment
我所行的路，你必看顧。我腳步若偏離正路，祢必知道。
You keep my steps in your sight. If I should depart from your way, you would know it.
— 希伯來書 9:27
— Hebrews 9:27
只要，一息尚存，萬事可期\n不然，一息若斷，萬事皆空
While one breath remains, everything is still possible\nIf that breath is cut, everything is void
你們要謹慎行事，不要像愚昧人，當像智慧人。要愛惜光陰，因為現今的世代邪惡。
Be prudent, like sensible people, not like fools. Make the most of your time, for these are evil days.
— Ephesians 5:15-16
人，還有多少天？\n可歎智慧人死亡，與愚昧人無異
Man, how many days are left to you?\nA wise man dies — no different from a fool
其實明天如何，你們還不知道。你們的生命是甚麼呢？你們原來是一片雲霧，出現少時就不見了。
You do not know what tomorrow will bring. What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
— James 4:14
你要保守你心，勝過保守一切\n因為一生的果效是由心發出
Guard your heart above all else,\nfor everything you do flows from it
人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？
What can a person gain that is worth exchanging their life for?
— 馬太福音 16:26
— Matthew 16:26
我們一生的年日是七十歲\n若是強壯可到八十歲\n但其中所矜誇的不過是勞苦愁煩
Seventy years may be all our days,\nor, if we have the strength, eighty years;\nyet their span is only toil and trouble.
無人有權力掌管生命，將生命留住；也無人有權力掌管死期。
No one has power over his own life to retain it; no one has power over the day of his death.
— 傳道書 8:8
— Ecclesiastes 8:8
生死，到底是甚麼？\n從何而來，往那而去？
What, after all, is life and death?\nWhere do we come from, and where do we go?
因為生者都必往那裡去，死者卻不能回到這裡來。
For the living must go to the place of the dead, but the dead cannot return to the place of the living.
— 傳道書
— Ecclesiastes
死亡，正靜悄悄地\n在時代巨輪裡不斷加速
Death, quietly, keeps accelerating\nas the great wheel of the age turns on
懷著悲傷與敬畏的心，靜默地記錄。願逝者安息，願生者息懷。
Recorded in silence, with sorrow and reverence. May the departed rest; may the living be comforted.
